meta.name: attack-tree-construction
meta.description: Build comprehensive attack trees to visualize threat paths. Use when mapping attack scenarios, identifying defense gaps, or communicating security risks to stakeholders.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 构建攻击树,可视化威胁路径与防御盲区。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果想梳理攻击场景并清晰呈现给干系人。
copy.tagline_en: Visualize attack paths and identify security gaps.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to clarify attack scenarios and present risks to stakeholders.

howto.what: Claude 会按描述生成结构化攻击树:包含根目标、子目标(OR/AND节点)和叶子节点,标注难度、成本、检测风险等属性;还能找最易/最便宜路径、列出未缓解攻击,并导出 JSON 或 Mermaid 图。
howto.when: 当用户要求绘制攻击树、梳理攻击路径时触发,典型场景包括映射攻击场景、识别防御漏洞、向相关方说明安全风险等。

say.text: 帮我构建一个账号接管场景的攻击树
say.note: Claude 会生成带节点和属性的攻击树结构

say.text: 分析这个系统最容易被攻击的路径并生成攻击树
say.note: Claude 会计算难度最低的攻击路径

say.text: 把攻击树导出成 Mermaid 图
say.note: Claude 输出 Mermaid 流程图格式

howto.what_en: Claude builds structured attack trees from your scenario: root goals, OR/AND sub-goals, and leaf attacks, each annotated with difficulty, cost, detection risk, and time. It can find easiest/cheapest/stealthiest paths, list unmitigated attacks, and export to JSON or Mermaid diagrams.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks to map attack scenarios, identify defense gaps, or explain security risks to stakeholders—typically by requesting an attack tree or threat path visualization.

say_en.text: Build an attack tree for an account takeover scenario.
say_en.note: Claude generates the tree with nodes and attributes.

say_en.text: Analyze the easiest attack path and draw an attack tree.
Export the attack tree as a Mermaid diagram.
